rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: Parliament's release dated Wednesday 22 May 2019 says the National Assembly 'today elected' Mr Matamela Cyril Ramaphosa as President of the Republic and that 'he will now be inaugurated as President of the Republic of South Africa on Saturday'.

locator.section: Dated first paragraph and second paragraph

rows.role_title: President of the Republic of South Africa
rows.text: The same release states that 'Mr Ramaphosa was first elected, unanimously, as President on 15 February 2018'.
